description: T-5123 (SPEC-0039 U6): how a deleted single cell prints, on another sheet and on its own, after delete_row 4 on S. S!C3:C5 hold 4,1,2; on S, E2 =C4 and F2 =$C$4 sit in a row that stays, E6 =C4 and F6 =$C$4 in a row that moves up. Sheet F holds A1 =S!C4, A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =S!$C$4+1, A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =SUM(S!C4,S!C5) (a deleted cell beside a live one), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), then the value and FORMULATEXT of S!E2 (A7, A8), S!F2 (A9, A10), S!E6 (A11, A12) and S!F6 (A13, A14); the references to E6 and F6 follow the moved cells.
